## Activity

During November 2024, West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 434 captures. Activity was monitored through the reporting period, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The available activity indicates that image capture continued without a reported interruption affecting the overall volume. The site should continue to review session arrangements and maintain the current process for recording completed captures.

## Image quality

Of the images submitted for review, 32 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 7.4. This result should be considered alongside local session conditions and the consistency of image acquisition. Ongoing attention to image quality, including capture technique and equipment checks, may help reduce the number of images that cannot be used for grading.

## Grading

Grading identified 111 referable results during the month. The median lag from capture to grading was 6 days. This provides a measure of the usual wait for results to be reviewed and supports continued monitoring of workflow performance. Results requiring referral should continue to be managed through the established clinical pathway, with activity and turnaround reviewed as part of routine site oversight.
